QUOTE: The index's own inventory notes that a file whose extension no grammar handles is not indexed at all, so "in scope" and "indexed" are not the same set.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer notes that in-scope files may not be indexed because no grammar handles their extension. It names neither filter the item requires: the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read, or binary classification dropping files whose extension lies about them.
